headline: Blues end scoring drought, sink Bruins 4–1

sections.label: 1st period
sections.text: Casey Mittelstadt picked off a Joel Hofer clearing attempt behind the Blues' net, and James Hagens tipped his feed past Hofer at 5:28 for a 1–0 lead. At 15:43, four seconds into a St. Louis power play, Jimmy Snuggerud one-timed Philip Broberg's pass inside the near post to tie it 1–1, ending the Blues' 138:38 scoreless stretch. St. Louis outshot Boston 10–8 in the period.

sections.label: 2nd period
sections.text: Broberg wristed a shot from the slot over Jeremy Swayman's glove at 5:17 after Connor McMichael found him from behind the net, making it 2–1. At 12:08, Robert Thomas, left unmarked in the slot, took a pass from Justin Barron and beat Swayman high for 3–1.

sections.label: 3rd period
sections.text: Marco Sturm shuffled his lines, moving David Pastrnak around, and Boston outshot St. Louis 14–2, but Hofer stopped all 14. Jake Neighbours put away the rebound of a Broberg shot on the power play at 12:42 for the 4–1 final; the Blues went 2-for-3 on the power play, Boston 0-for-2.

performers.name: James Hagens
performers.note: His fifth goal and 10th point, second among NHL rookies behind Gavin McKenna's 11, was Boston's only score.

performers.name: Casey Mittelstadt
performers.note: Created the goal by picking off Hofer's clearing attempt; afterward he said it's not "time to panic."

performers.name: Jeremy Swayman
performers.note: Allowed four goals on 18 shots, two of them on Blues power plays.

oppLine: Robert Thomas and Philip Broberg each had a goal and two assists, and Joel Hofer stopped 31 of 32 shots.
takeaway: Two straight regulation losses left Boston without a point on the trip and its Atlantic lead at one point, with 12 of the next 14 games at home.
